label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User input from request.getParameter flows through regex validation (^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$) and reaches SQL table name at line 25. While validation restricts characters, it does not whitelist specific tables - an attacker could supply a valid-looking table name that exists in the database or exploit database-specific behaviors. The resolved sink value is param (validated user input) concatenated into SQL statement. This is a classic SQL injection pattern with insufficient mitigation.

evidence.note: User input param flows to SQL table name concatenation without proper sanitization or whitelist
